posts.title: Oat is a Minimal UI library
posts.description: Oat is a Minimal UI library If I were to lean into a new UI library, this would likely be it. It’s the most minimal yet complete library that I’ve seen. It’s basically shadcn meets semantic HTML. Tags: UI

Try it here: clippy.keithschacht.com Best in Chrome. Desktop only. No sign up.
